description: List the edit history of one course page: revision numbers, editors and dates. Read-only. Students often cannot see page history, in which case Canvas returns a permission error. Read a revision with get_page_revision.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

page_url.description: The page's URL slug, e.g. "week-1-overview" (the last part of the page address). Get it from list_pages.

name: list_page_revisions
title: List Page Revisions
